verdict.rationale: Relay's docs confirm role-based permissions and automated bill-pay approvals ('define roles', 'delegate tasks, automate approvals' in relay-docs-2/relay-docs-4), which supports designated teammates approving payments, but there's no detail on a specific 'one-click' approve-and-send flow or granular approval-permission configuration UI. Community reviews note some users experienced 'issues with permissions' (relay-comm-2), a mild caveat rather than a hard contradiction. missing for 10: explicit documentation of one-click approval/send workflow, granular approval-role setup screenshots, and independent confirmation the approval flow works smoothly.
